diagnostic: Static magnetic field magnitude and physical geometry
field_profile: All physical cell centres. Orthonormal P1 coefficients from zzim-geo_int_bmag.gkyl and zzim-geo_corn_mc2nu_pos_deflated.gkyl evaluated at xi=0. No smoothing or normalization.
node_check: Use the R and Z components (0 and 1) of zzim-geo_corn_nodes.gkyl directly. The first and last nodes match Z_min/Z_max and grid_inp.zmin/zmax in sim.c. End fields are sampled at the adjacent cell centres.

analytic_exhibit.geometry: L=sum over ±a of 1/(1+((Z±a)/width)^2). F=B0*L/L(0), psi=r²F/2. Bisect width on [0.09,0.46] m for the requested peak/midplane ratio. Below 3, F=B0+(R-1)*(F3-B0)/2.
analytic_exhibit.quantities: Eight azimuths on one flux surface. Launch velocities, common magnetic moment, quadratic ambipolar potential and collisionless trajectories are analytic visitor settings.

particle.source: sim.c and core/zero/gkyl_const.h at the recorded Gkeyll changeset

analytic_exhibit.launch: v_parallel0=(2i-7)V/7, i=0..7. Five releases per line, staggered by one fifth of the opening bounce or escape/relaunch cycle, rounded to 1/60 exhibit s and capped at 1.5 exhibit s. Live edits resample each particle at its existing launch age. Reset restores the trial clock and controls.
analytic_exhibit.potential: Phi=delta_phi*(1-(Z/Zt)^2) inside the rings and zero throughout the expanders. The escape threshold satisfies m*v_parallel0^2/2 = max over [0,Zt] of mu*(B(Z)-B0) + q*(phi(Z)-phi(0)), with q=+e. Draw the branches where a finite turning region exists.
analytic_exhibit.orbit: Invert time of flight and integrated gyro phase on the first reachable energy-conserving leg. Reflect trapped legs by symmetry. A passing particle crosses the throat with phi held at zero through the expander, fades at the displayed tip over 0.16 exhibit s, and relaunches at the midplane with a fresh trail.
analytic_exhibit.field_line_colour: Bright blue for returning launches, dark blue-grey for escaping launches, pale grey for rest or boundary. Colour encodes the particle outcome at the current controls.
